This car hotspot is saved

\"%1$s\" is saved in the system. Keeping it makes the phone join it automatically when in range, and if it has no internet the phone may lose mobile data.\n\nForget only stops automatic joining and does not affect this session; if the car hotspot provides internet, choose Keep.

Could not join the car hotspot

Joining \"%1$s\" automatically did not succeed (the hotspot may be out of range, or the system refused).\n\nRetry joins again (first silently, then with the system prompt if needed); or connect manually in Wi-Fi settings (the password is on the clipboard).
Retry
Use the current Wi-Fi?

If the phone and the receiver are on the same router (for example DiPlay same-LAN mode), you can use the current Wi-Fi.\n\nMake sure both are on the same network; if the receiver has its own hotspot, join \"%1$s\" in Wi-Fi settings.
Use current Wi-Fi
Join the car hotspot

mcarplay will join the \"%1$s\" hotspot. It has no internet, so the system may switch back to the previous Wi-Fi.\n\nIf the connection drops, join \"%2$s\" yourself in Wi-Fi settings (a manual connection is not switched back).
Join automatically
Connected to %1$s

The head unit has not sent connection info over Bluetooth yet (0x4301). Treat the current network \"%1$s\" as the car hotspot and try mDNS/gateway now? (Keep waiting keeps Bluetooth alive until the head unit sends it.)
